[SWS_PHM_00010] Not initialized Health Channel
⌈
If the container
HealthStatusInitValue does not exist or the Health Channel does not already
have an initial value, the Platform Health Management shall treat the correspond-
ing Health Status as undefined and not use it until the corresponding Health
Channel has been updated for the first time.
⌋
